questions.prompt: How do bereavement and grief differ?
questions.answer: Bereavement concerns circumstances of death-related loss; grief concerns responses to loss.

questions.prompt: What does the dual-process model distinguish?
questions.feedback: Do not turn the model into a schedule.

questions.prompt: Does renewed sadness establish failed recovery?
questions.answer: No; experiences can vary over time.

questions.prompt: When may qualified support be appropriate?
questions.answer: Whenever wanted or when persistent difficulties warrant assessment.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Explains variability and distinguishes model-based description from prescribed stages or clinical assessment.
scoring.transfer: Construct a fictional two-week timeline with changing loss-related and practical demands. Offer two optional support routes and identify uncertainty. Explain why the timeline cannot predict recovery or determine whether a clinical condition is present.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
